The anchor is `<!-- tb id=<slug> page rect layer extraction -->`; only `id` identifies a section (RULE-25). Re-import returns updates/unanchored/orphans/missing.
fflate zips document.pdf + notes.md + thinkboard.json; the seam is pure and takes rows + bytes.
